text:
jyoti: Need a one-pager managers can use for hybrid hires (day0-day7 checklist + copy-paste 30/60/90). New SWE starts Tue. Can someone distill?
rafa: Here's a tight version I use — 6 bullets for day0-7 and a tiny 30/60/90. Manager can DM this to the hire and attach to Notion.
rafa: Day0 (before start): fill intake form, confirm shipping/pickup, DM new hire with arrival logistics. Day1: 30-min desk/setup with IT/buddy, intro standup, assign buddy. Day2-3: permissions + codebase walk, simple repo PR exercise. Day4-5: product context + first small task. End of week: 30-min check-in and set 30-day goals.
rafa: Quick 30/60/90 (copyable):
- 30: Understand codebase, shipping one small fix, 2 learning goals.
- 60: Own a feature area, deliver medium scope task, feedback on processes.
- 90: Lead rollout for a minor feature, propose one improvement to infra or docs.
kevin: Adding calendar templates managers can paste (short events):
```
Day1 09:00-09:30: Welcome + logistics (Manager + IT + Buddy)
Day1 10:00-10:30: Team intro + standup (All hands)
Day3 14:00-14:30: 30-day goals sync (Manager + New hire)
Week1 Fri 11:00-11:30: Week1 wrap + feedback
```
kevin: And a DM template for day0: "Hey <name> — excited to have you! You can pick up your laptop Mon 9-11am (Bldg C, reception) or we can ship to your address. Reply with preference. Parking: bring ID for visitor pass. See you Tue 9am for quick setup. — <manager>"
mei: Suggest adding two manager-only checklist items: schedule first-month skip-level invite and set expectations doc (one pager) uploaded to Notion. Also explicitly assign who will open repos and add GitHub access within 24h.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: Please ensure security training enrollment and SSO provisioning are triggered in intake form. People Ops auto-invites to #new-hires once intake is complete.
badge-bot: Badge pickup windows: Tue 8:30-10:30 & Wed 15:00-16:30 at Security Desk. Share employee ID for pre-approval.
jyoti: Love this. Can we also include a short "what success looks like in 30 days" blurb managers can paste into goals?
rafa: Sure, paste this: "By 30 days: able to navigate codebase, deploy small change with guidance, and present a learning plan for next 60 days."
kevin: I'll bundle the one-pager, calendar ICS template, and the DM text into a single Notion block and add a checkbox intake field: "wants in-office intro breakfast" and "needs travel reimbursement".
peopleops-bot: Action items created: (1) Publish manager one-pager -> kevin, (2) Update intake form fields -> people-ops, (3) Confirm badge windows -> badge-bot. Due EOD today.
jyoti: Thanks all 44d — if anyone has a short example 30/60/90 doc with measurable metrics (e.g., PRs merged, features owned), DM me and I'll include as an appendix.
